title: Garlicky Green Beans
description: Bright, snappy beans in browned garlic butter.
imageAlt: Green beans with golden garlic on a floral plate

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Add salt to a pot of boiling water, then boil 1 pound green beans until bright and just tender, about 4 minutes. Drain well.

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.text: Melt the butter over medium heat until it smells nutty. Add 2 sliced garlic cloves and cook 30 seconds.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the beans and lemon juice, toss for a minute, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
